'''R5-G19''' was an [[R5 series astromech droid]]<ref name="Hasbro" /> that served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="GA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] to [[4 ABY]].</ref> the [[astromech droid]] was stood beside another astromech in the briefing room of the<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80 Star Cruiser]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> ''[[Home One]]'' when members of the [[Alliance High Command|Alliance leadership]], including [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]], [[Mon Mothma]], and [[General]] [[Crix Madine]], gave a briefing to the assembled rebels on their plans to [[Battle of Endor|attack]] the Empire's [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] in the [[Endor system]]. The ''Home One'' later took part in the successful attack.<ref name="ROTJ" />

R5-G19 stood 97 [[centimeter]]s tall and as an [[R-series]] [[droid]] was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> It had [[Color|black]] [[sensor]]s and white and burgundy plating.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
R5-G19 was created for the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The briefing room scene was filmed on Stage 5 at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[February 12]] and [[February 25]] in [[1982]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> The droid was first identified in [[2014]] when it received an action figure in the ''[[Star Wars: The Black Series]]'' line released by [[Hasbro]].<ref name="Hasbro" />
